core_smsc_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the SMSC server (SMS Center).

core_smsc_port.description: Port number for SMPP (default 2775), HTTP (e.g., 8080), etc.

core_smsc_username.description: System ID (SMPP) or username (HTTP) for SMSC authentication.

core_smsc_password.description: Password for SMSC authentication (never use default in production).

core_log_file.description: Path to the main Kannel log file. Use 'stdout' to log to console.

core_pidfile.description: Path to the PID file for the Kannel process.

admin_enabled.description: Enable the Kannel admin web interface for monitoring and control.

admin_port.description: Port for the admin interface (e.g., http://localhost:13000).

admin_password.description: Password for admin interface (MUST be changed in production).

admin_accept_ip.description: List of allowed IP addresses for admin interface access (CIDR not supported).

sms_delivery_report_enabled.description: Enable SMS delivery reports (DLR) to track message status.

dlr_db_type.description: Database type if using DLR database backend (e.g., 'mysql', 'postgres').

dlr_db_host.description: Hostname or IP of the DLR database server.

dlr_db_port.description: Port of the DLR database server.

dlr_db_password.description: Password for DLR database user (empty = no password).

bearerbox_links.description: List of SMSC link configurations (one per SMSC connection).

smsc_id.description: Unique identifier for this SMSC link (e.g., 'primary', 'backup').

transceiver_mode.description: Set to 'yes' for SMPP transceiver mode.

max_smsc_connections.description: Maximum concurrent connections to this SMSC.

keepalive.description: Keepalive interval (seconds) for persistent SMPP connections.

reconnect_delay.description: Delay (seconds) before reconnecting to SMSC after disconnect.

smsc_ready_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) to wait for SMSC to become ready.

smsbox_enabled.description: Enable the SMS Box to accept SMS submissions via HTTP API.

smsbox_port.description: HTTP port for SMS Box (e.g., http://localhost:13001/cgi-bin/sendsms).

smsbox_host.description: Host to bind SMS Box (e.g., 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

smsbox_smsc.description: SMS center ID to use (must match a bearerbox_link.smsc_id).

smsbox_max_sms_per_connection.description: Maximum SMS messages allowed per HTTP connection.

relay_enabled.description: Enable SMS relay mode for interconnecting Kannel instances.

file_smsc_sources.description: List of file-based SMS sources (for batch SMS injection from files).

spool_dir.description: Directory to monitor for incoming SMS files.

done_dir.description: Directory to move processed SMS files to.

failed_dir.description: Directory to move failed SMS files to.
